Average body mass (g) by species, after cleaning: Adelie ≈ 3,500.0 g; Chinstrap ≈ 3,907.8 g; Gentoo ≈ 5,248.3 g (54 rows used).

Problems found and fixes applied:
1. body_mass_g was stored as text (one value written as "3,800") — converted to numbers, no values lost.
2. Species label misspellings "Adeile" (1 row) and "Gentto" (2 rows) — merged into the allowed labels Adelie and Gentoo per the rules file.

Caveat: the three excluded rows' true masses are unknown; if they can be corrected, the averages would change slightly.
